ns2:course.label: Ethical Dilemmas in Business
ns2:course.description: Examines business decision making and the role ethics plays in that process. Analysis of how managers behave and whether ethical choices are knowingly made or only realized thereafter. Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: First year of the MBA program or equivalent.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to MBA: (PT) Business Adm -- UIUC, MS: Technology Management-UIUC, or MBA:Bus Administration -UIUC.
